crossRefs.note: “ ‘When a man dedicates his house to be holy to Yahweh, then the priest shall evaluate it, whether it is good or bad.…
“If anyone commits a trespass, and sins unwittingly regarding Yahweh’s holy things, then he shall bring his trespass…
He shall bring his trespass offering to Yahweh: a ram without defect from the flock, according to your estimation, for…
You shall redeem those who are to be redeemed of them from a month old, according to your estimation, for five shekels…
Jehoash said to the priests, “All the money of the holy things that is brought into Yahweh’s house, in current money…
All your valuations shall be according to the shekel of the sanctuary: twenty gerahs to the shekel.
They shall give this, everyone who passes over to those who are counted, half a shekel according to the shekel of the…

translations.web: your valuation of a male from twenty years old to sixty years old shall be fifty shekels of silver, according to the shekel of the sanctuary.
translations.bsb: if the valuation concerns a male from twenty to sixty years of age, then your valuation shall be fifty shekels of silver, according to the sanctuary shekel.
translations.kjv: And thy estimation shall be of the male from twenty years old even unto sixty years old, even thy estimation shall be fifty shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary.
translations.asv: And thy estimation shall be of the male from twenty years old even unto sixty years old, even thy estimation shall be fifty shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary.
